Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Bargain trips now skip worlds already marked visited within the 48-hour visited-world window. Starting a bargain trip on a partially visited datacentre now begins with the first unvisited world in that datacentre's configured world order. If every world in the selected datacentre was visited recently, the trip stops instead of repeating the same circuit.
